summary: Backend-only regression for the 'Subject to View' (unseen=True) PDF changes. New pytest suite (test_unseen_pdf.py, 3 tests) creates one UNSEEN and one SEEN submission via a real dealer login (minitest@example.com), admin-prices each, downloads /api/submissions/{id}/valuation.pdf, and asserts the extracted text. UNSEEN PDF contains the red banner 'VEHICLE UNSEEN — SUBJECT TO VIEW' and does NOT contain any of: CONDITION ASSESSMENT, Overall Condition, Mechanical (30%), Cosmetic (25%), Interior (25%), General (20%), SERVICE HISTORY, RECONDITIONING, Windscreen, Paint Evidence, Accident Damage. SEEN PDF still contains all four condition labels. Regression: all 9 test_license_disk_decode.py tests still pass. Backend startup clean (Application startup complete, no tracebacks). Static grep checks on both frontend files pass — both contain the required `!sub.unseen` / `!selected.unseen` guards around Condition, Service History and Reconditioning JSX.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5701 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Not related to this task but worth splitting into modules (submissions/valuation_pdf/kredo/admin) in a future refactor.

POST /api/submissions returns a nested wrapper `{submission: {...}, id: ...}` while other admin endpoints return the object at top level. Not a bug but the inconsistency tripped the initial test — worth normalising.

success_rate.frontend: not tested (static grep only, all guards present)

seed_data_creation: Two test submissions were created under minitest@example.com and admin-priced at R400,000 for PDF extraction: FB-000121 (unseen) and FB-000122 (seen). These are left in the DB but marked with notes='TEST_unseen_pdf' for easy cleanup by admin if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The unseen/seen PDF flow is stable. Extracted PDF text is dumped to /tmp/unseen_pdf.txt and /tmp/seen_pdf.txt during tests for debugging. If the layout changes again, look at server.py `_build_valuation_pdf` around lines 2566-2810.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration confirms E1's implementation, no bugs found.
